problem_statement: Build a brand-new Invoices page from scratch at the route /invoices on the Volt React Dashboard (CRA + @themesberg/react-bootstrap, HashRouter). The route does not exist yet (baseline renders an empty screen). Construct the full page inside the existing sidebar+navbar shell, reusing the site's design system (react-bootstrap Card/Table/Nav/Tab/Badge, Nunito Sans, the icon-shape counter tiles and breadcrumb header used across Transactions/Settings). The page must show: an 'Invoices Overview' header with breadcrumb and an Export CSV action; three status summary tiles (Paid / Pending / Overdue) with counts; and a react-bootstrap pill Tab.Container that switches between All Invoices / Paid / Pending / Overdue panes, each rendering an invoice table (Invoice #, Client, Date, Amount, Status badge). Clicking the Pending tab must reveal the 'Awaiting Payment' pane. The page must have no horizontal overflow at mobile (390px).
required_content: Breadcrumb header 'Invoices Overview' with subtitle 'Track billing status across all your client invoices in one place.'
'Export CSV' outline button in the header toolbar
Three summary tiles: Paid, Pending, Overdue, each with an icon-shape badge and a count
Pill nav Tab.Container with four tabs: All Invoices, Paid, Pending, Overdue
Each tab pane has a heading (All Invoices / Settled Invoices / Awaiting Payment / Past Due Invoices) and an invoice table
Invoice table columns: Invoice #, Client, Date, Amount, Status (colored Badge)
At least five seeded invoice rows including 'Northwind Traders' and 'Contoso Ltd.'
Clicking the Pending tab activates the 'Awaiting Payment' pane (interaction)
Visual palette must overlap the site theme (light #f5f8fb page bg, #ffffff cards, #6b7281 muted text) — do not use an off-brand color scheme.
design_constraints: Reuse @themesberg/react-bootstrap components (Card, Table, Nav, Tab, Badge, Breadcrumb, Button, ButtonGroup)
Render inside the RouteWithSidebar shell (Sidebar + Navbar + Footer) like other internal pages
Reuse the site's icon-shape counter-tile idiom and shadow-sm light-border cards
Status badges use success/warning/danger bootstrap variants
No horizontal overflow at 390px mobile width

Palette/theme tokens (match the site design system): page background #f5f8fb, card surfaces #ffffff, muted body text #6b7281, dark sidebar shell rgb(38,43,64); typography is Nunito Sans throughout (base 16px, tile counts ~28px).
Pane headings (All Invoices / Settled Invoices / Awaiting Payment / Past Due Invoices) are real headings rendered as an h2, h3 or h4 element; the header title 'Invoices Overview' is an h1.
author_notes: 方案A: baseline 缺 /invoices (top-level empty Route render=<></> outside sidebar shell, gotcha #12); reference 完整实现 Invoices page with react-bootstrap Tab.Container; bad 把 Tab.Container 改为 controlled activeKey='all' + onSelect no-op → 点 Pending tab 无反应,'Awaiting Payment' 面板永不激活 → 仅 interaction gate FAIL (static dom 仍过). HashRouter → state path=#/invoices. CRA react-scripts 3.4.3 + bootstrap 5.0.0-beta1 scss 需 sass pin 到 1.32.13 (abs()/color-contrast ParserError swap fix) + NODE_OPTIONS=--openssl-legacy-provider + homepage=''. 三份工作区源码 md5 互不相同.
